blurb: Guests can swim with manatees in Kings Bay with guided tours including wetsuits and snorkels. Boat cruises offer wildlife viewing without getting in the water. Scalloping tours allow guests to find and collect bay scallops in shallow waters.
extraNote: Reservations are required for manatee tours · Manatee tours operate year-round with best times early morning and in colder months Nov-Mar · Private tours can be arranged · Tours take off from right behind the Adventure Center at Plantation Resort on Crystal River
